I tested it out on a cystic pimple last night that has been around for far too long, and to my surprise, it somehow worked at getting some of the pus out and minimizing how large the bump was. I leave it on my face overnight or for 12+ hours and it does not budge (and I sleep with a blanket over my face!). It sucks out most of the pus of the pimple, but you might have to squeeze the rest out with clean hands or cleanse afterward. Another thing I don't like about the patches is that the edge you peel up first becomes bent and doesn't stick on your face. I feel that could be fixed by using tweezers but I don't have one. avis.titre: Must have in my glam bag

On both of those occasions I did my normal evening skin routine of washing, toner, serums, & moisturizer. I waited awhile while everything soaked in and before bed I put one of these little patches on my zit and went to sleep. The patch stayed in place and the next morning the zit was considerably improved. The first time it was gone by morning. This last one went down to where I could feel where it was but it was no longer a raised bump. Will 100% keep a pack of these on hand at all times!

avis.titre: K beauty staple, it's my HG!
avis.texte: I learned about these a few years ago and now they're a staple. I'm blemish free at a young 57 yo, but I recently got a giant blemish on my chin. I washed my face gently, and added this patch for at least 24 hours. It gently brings the gunk to the surface and removes it while keeping it protected, and it's invisible. The first time I used it, it seemed like magic it worked so well at removing all the gunk. This time, it brought it to the surface, and probably needed several more hours to fully release on its own. But the patch was expired, hence my recent repurchase of these at 21 Days of Beauty. I did end up helping things along on my own, gently toned it, added another patch in case anymore gunk needed to be expelled, then finally dabbed a bit of AHA on it. It healed nicely with a minimum of hyperpigmentation on my dark skin. Sometimes I'll dab a bit of centella ampoule as well for healing. Leave it to K beauty to come up with something so gentle and effective without being in any way drying. Having dry skin and blemishes is a tricky combo for me. But they've got you covered. Love it!
